summary: On Holding AG filed a 6-K reporting its 2026 Investor Day, headlined by an inaugural share repurchase authorization of up to USD 1 billion of Class A Ordinary Shares, to run through end-2029, alongside 2029 targets of a high-teens constant-currency net sales CAGR, at least 65% gross margin, at least 22% adjusted EBITDA margin, and greater than 20% adjusted EBITDA CAGR. No price per share, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The buyback signals disciplined capital allocation and management confidence; watch execution pace, free-float reduction, and whether repurchases offset equity comp dilution.
